sample_farthest_points: subsample K points from a point cloud using iterative farthest point sampling for uniform coverage
sample_farthest_points_naive: subsample K points from a point cloud using a pure Python naive farthest point sampling implementation
run_farthest_point_sampling: run farthest point sampling on a batch of point clouds with a specified number of samples K
test_farthest_point_sampling: test the farthest point sampling function by comparing the optimized C++ and naive Python implementations
review_farthest_point_sampling: review the farthest point sampling algorithm to understand how it selects points with maximum nearest neighbor distance
